release_name: AI Bridge Controller UI, Offline Rebar Studio & ViewportCapture Integration
highlights: Interactive AI Bridge Controller Window (AIGRAVWelcomeWindow): Real-time HTTP Server Bridge status badge, editable Port Listener, Test Connection self-probe, Cari Port Bebas (+1), Revit PID & Requests Served telemetry, and Restart Bridge action

Offline Rebar Studio & Rebar Suite (AIGRAV.Skills.RebarExtension + UI/RebarSuite): Selection-driven 3D Viewport & 2D CAD preview, Beam/Column/Foundation/Floor rebar builders, SNI lap/splice solver (<= 12m stock), Reinforcement Browser dockable pane, Smart Mark, Auto-Tag, Native BBS Schedule, and CSV/BVBS export
Live Viewport Capture Engine (AIGRAV.Skills.ViewportCapture): High-resolution visual viewport/3D view exporter for automated QA visual inspection

Unified Solution Build & Multi-PC Updater (AIGRAV.RevitBridge.slnx & sync-aigrav.ps1): Included AIGRAV.Skills.BimAudit, AIGRAV.Skills.ViewportCapture, and AIGRAV.Skills.RebarExtension in the main solution, plus multi-port hot-reload across 8765-8775 and %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\dotnet fallback
fixes: Fixed AIGRAV Ribbon click handler (AIGRAVApp.ToggleAIGRAV) so clicking AIGRAV opens/focuses the AI Bridge Controller without silently shutting down the active bridge, and initialized the ribbon port tooltip at startup
Fixed AIGRAVVersionChecker root resolution to detect version.json and sync-aigrav.ps1 dynamically across D:\AIGRAV, C:\AIGRAV, or the active assembly tree
Updated AIGRAVSkillLoader duplicate-assembly guard so Skills\ DLLs sharing an identity with host assemblies never trigger Revit 2026 AssemblyLoadContext errors
Built and verified all 11 solution projects with 0 errors and passed all 25 deterministic RebarExtension solver unit tests
